advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Handle the zero/absent `github.event.before` SHA (e.g. treat as empty range or fall back) so a new-branch first push does not error the changed-rubric job.
advisory.finding: The push-event ref `github.event.before` is the all-zero SHA (0000000000000000000000000000000000000000) on the first push to a newly-created branch; `_changed_paths_since` runs `git diff --name-only <ref>..HEAD` with check=True, so `git diff 000...0000..HEAD` fails and the command returns exit 1. The job is continue-on-error so main is not reddened, but the eval never runs for that push.
scenarios: First push to a brand-new branch where github.event.before is the zero SHA
Force-push scenarios where before is not an ancestor

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Separate the machine-parseable selection list from live calibration report output (e.g. report to stderr, or print selection before/independent of reports) to keep stdout unambiguous.
evidence: live report also to stdout: `_write_criteria_report(report, output=args.output)` -> `sys.stdout.write(...)` (src/rebar/_cli/_llm_eval_commands.py:264, 267-287)
docs promise a clean id list: 'prints selected criterion ids and exits 0' (docs/exit-codes.md:177)
advisory.finding: When the live path runs, `_run_selected_criteria_live` writes full calibration reports to stdout via `_write_criteria_report`, the same stream that already emitted the machine-parseable sorted selection id list. A consumer reading stdout for the one-id-per-line selection would also ingest report lines, blurring the documented 'prints selected criterion ids (sorted, one per line)' contract.
scenarios: Any live invocation with credentials present where a caller parses stdout for the selection

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test that `rebar criteria eval T8 --changed-since <ref>` exits 2 with the mutual-exclusivity error.
evidence: tests/unit/test_changed_criteria.py: every _run_changed_since call passes only --changed-since; no test supplies both a positional id and --changed-since
search for `mutually exclusive` in tests shows no coverage of this criteria-eval path
advisory.finding: The mutual-exclusivity exit-2 path (positional criterion id AND --changed-since supplied together) is newly added but has no test. Named violating input: `rebar criteria eval T8 --changed-since <ref>` must exit 2 and emit the mutual-exclusivity error; a regression that dropped the check would go undetected.
advisory.suggested_fix: Add a test invoking the command with both a positional id and --changed-since, asserting returncode==2 and 'mutually exclusive' in stderr.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test that a bad/nonexistent --changed-since ref exits 1 and names the ref on stderr.
evidence: src/rebar/_cli/_llm_eval_commands.py:195-201: `except subprocess.CalledProcessError as exc:` ... `sys.stderr.write(f"Error: git diff failed for --changed-since {args.changed_since!r}")` ... `return 1`
search for `git diff failed for --changed-since` returns only the source line, no test
advisory.finding: The git-diff-failure branch (bad --changed-since ref -> subprocess.CalledProcessError -> exit 1 naming the ref) is newly added but untested. Every test asserts returncode==0; the error path is never exercised. Named violating input: `rebar criteria eval --changed-since not-a-real-ref`.
advisory.suggested_fix: Add a test running against a seeded repo with `--changed-since deadbeef` (a ref not in the repo), asserting returncode==1 and the ref appears in stderr.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test exercising a changed `.rebar/prompts/plan-review-*.md` path (mapped criterion selected, unmapped path warned).
evidence: .rebar/prompts/plan-review-project-portability.md and siblings exist in the repo
tests/unit/test_changed_criteria.py:27,55: REVIEWERS = 'src/rebar/llm/reviewers'; _touch_rubric only writes plan_review_<c>.md under REVIEWERS — no test writes a .rebar/prompts/plan-review-*.md path
advisory.finding: The second branch of `_has_rubric_shape` — the `.rebar/prompts/plan-review-*.md` layout — is newly added and never exercised; all tests touch only `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_*.md`. That prompt-library layout is real in the repo, so the untested disjunct guards a live path. Named violating input: a changed path `.rebar/prompts/plan-review-bogus.md` should be reported as unmapped.
advisory.suggested_fix: Add a test that seeds a `.rebar/prompts/plan-review-*.md` change and asserts the corresponding selection/warning behavior, mirroring the reviewers-dir tests.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a producer-liveness anchor to the weekly-sweep test (assert `resolved` is non-empty, or that a known non-epic prompt id is present) before trusting the disjointness assertion.
evidence: tests/unit/test_changed_criteria.py:168-176: `resolved: set[str] = set()` populated only inside the glob loop; `assert resolved.isdisjoint(EPIC_PROMPT_IDS)`
An empty `resolved` (glob matched zero files, or no spec has `dataset`) makes the disjointness assertion trivially pass — the check cannot distinguish 'epic ids absent' from 'no specs loaded'
advisory.finding: test_epic_prompt_ids_absent_from_weekly_sweep is a fail-open oracle: its verdict is derived from `resolved`, populated by globbing eval_specs, but there is no liveness check that the glob matched any spec. If the glob matches nothing (spec dir renamed/moved) or no spec carries `dataset`, `resolved` is empty and `resolved.isdisjoint(EPIC_PROMPT_IDS)` is trivially true — the test passes whether the epic ids are genuinely absent OR the producer read nothing.
advisory.suggested_fix: Before the disjointness assert, add `assert resolved, 'no dataset-bearing eval specs found — glob/layout broken'` (or assert an expected baseline prompt id is in `resolved`).

blocking.checklist_item: - [ ] Make the CI changed-rubric job assert the live tier actually ran (non-empty selection + backends present) instead of silently exiting 0 when credentials/agents are absent.
evidence: CI step just runs `rebar criteria eval --changed-since "$CHANGED_SINCE"` with no assertion the live tier executed (.github/workflows/prompt-eval.yml:84-85)
blocking.finding: In the CI job, `_criteria_eval_changed_since` runs the paid live eval only when `_live_criteria_eval_available()` is true, otherwise it prints the selection and returns 0 silently. If the ANTHROPIC/OPENAI secrets are unset/misconfigured or the agents extra fails to load in CI, the 'Run changed-rubric criterion evals' step still exits 0 having done NO live eval — a green step is indistinguishable from 'ran and all criteria clean'. The absence of a live run is invisible.
scenarios: agents extra install partially fails but the CLI still imports
